verdict.rationale: Whether source is available under an open license is a fair question for any software product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack says Spline's editor or runtime source is published under an open license. Scene code export, the Spline Runtime npm package and the self-hosted ZIP are export and integration features, not open-licensed product source, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
